This ambiguity caused WebSurfer to remain in the NCBI context, repeat ineffective searches, and ultimately result in task failure.

hypotheses.rationale: The Orchestrator instructed WebSurfer to search both NCBI and Ensembl Genome Browser without ensuring a proper and complete transition to Ensembl after failing to locate the GFF3 file on NCBI. This led to WebSurfer remaining in the NCBI Genome Data Viewer context, resulting in step repetition and eventual premature termination.
